title: Influence of dextran deswelling on graft preparation and clinical outcomes in DMEK

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, ext-link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: DMEK for corneal endothelial disease (recipient diagnoses not reported); eyes with vision-limiting comorbidity, previous vitrectomy, glaucoma-filtering or corneal surgery, or follow-up under 12 months excluded; organ-cultured donor corneas from the Cologne eye bank (donor age 52-74 years)

groups.description: Group A: organ-cultured donor cornea moved to 6% dextran T-500 deswelling medium at least 24 h before surgery (tissue kept as potential PK/DALK backup); DMEK graft prepared by the surgeon directly before transplantation; SF6 20% tamponade; retrospective 2018-2022

Group B: organ-cultured donor cornea with a final medium exchange into dextran-free medium (swollen tissue) at least 24 h before surgery; DMEK graft prepared by the surgeon directly before transplantation; SF6 20% tamponade; retrospective 2018-2022

exclusions.reason: Follow-up time given as a range

exclusions.what: Table 2 ECC and BSCVA rows and the 'p-value 12 months after DMEK' column
exclusions.reason: Not central corneal thickness; p-values are not admissible

notes: Both groups differ only in the donor-cornea storage medium of the final culture step (dextran deswelling versus dextran-free), allocated by logistical and surgical-scheduling considerations in a retrospective series, without an investigational agent declared as an experimental arm: both are control-role groups.

Group sizes conflict within the article: abstract and Results give group A n = 16 and group B n = 15 (consistent with re-bubbling 4/16 = 25.0% and 5/15 = 33.3%), whereas Table 1 lists npatients 15 (A) and 16 (B); n follows the abstract/Results.
The CCT measuring device is not stated in the article (method 'unstated').
Results text gives the 12-month CCT SD with slightly different rounding than Table 2; the Table 2 cells are cited.

series.baseline_label: Pre-operative CCT of the operated eye (Table 2 'Central corneal thickness, CCT [µm]' row 'Pre-operative'); measuring device not stated
